fits.v: yes — the deck goes in as built
fits.why: Single-DIN dash. The oldest and simplest case in this directory.

aperture.why: Confirm on your own car; the console was revised during the run.

depth_mm.v: shallow — the NA console is small and the tunnel is close behind it
depth_mm.why: This is the number that decides whether the build fits, and it is the one no listing tells you. Measure from the back of the aperture to the nearest obstruction before you commit to a chassis depth.

fascia_adapter.v: search: “Mazda MX-5 NA single DIN fascia”
fascia_adapter.why: Often not needed: the original surround usually suits a single-DIN unit directly.

harness.why: ⚠️ Eunos Roadster imports may carry the JDM harness rather than the European one. Check which connector is actually behind your dash rather than ordering by model year.

aerial.why: Many NAs have a powered mast aerial — see the gotchas.

swc.v: none — no factory steering-wheel audio controls
swc.why: None known on any NA trim. Skip the interface box and the learning step.

illumination.v: dash dimmer at the ISO A connector

ignition.v: switched live at the ISO A connector
ignition.why: Standard ISO A7, commonly swapped with A4. Meter before connecting.

same_as_other_generations: ISO 7736 aperture and an ISO 10487 harness via an adapter, like every car here
No factory steering-wheel audio controls on NA or NB, so no interface box
market_notes: UK / EU / US / AU / JP share the single-DIN aperture; the harness connector is the thing most likely to differ on a Japanese import.
⚠️ The radio band plan follows where the car is driven, not where it was built. An import wants the plan of the country it is in now.
gotchas: A powered mast aerial is common on the NA and it will not rise on its own. The deck has no aerial-power output. If the car has a powered or amplified aerial it needs 12 V from a switched source of your own.
The deck is line-out only and has no amplifier. Plan for one, or accept that it will be quiet.
It is a convertible with a thirty-year-old hood. Water in the centre console is a known NA trait, not a hypothetical one — think about where the boards sit.
Depth. The NA console is the smallest in this directory; measure before building.

factory_amp.why: Same consequence: the deck is line level and needs an amplifier.

amp_space.v: behind the seats, or the boot
amp_space.why: ⚠️ Convertible, thirty years old, and water in the cabin is a known NA trait rather than a hypothetical. Mount high and dry.

din_options.v: 1-DIN only. The deck fills the aperture and **the amplifier has to live elsewhere in the car** — see the space note below.
